pieces.name: Black velvet cape
pieces.styleNotes: Floor-grazing black crushed velvet cape with a deep oxblood satin lining and a high collar for a dramatic Gothic silhouette. Look for handmade or vintage-inspired ties at the neck.
queries: handmade black velvet cape oxblood red satin lining Etsy
vintage gothic black crushed velvet cloak high collar
handmade long velvet vampire cape burgundy lined

matches.reason: Full-length black velvet cape with embossed red satin lining and a hood, matching the oxblood-lined look, though it is a mass-market Underwraps piece with a hood rather than a high collar.
Full-length hooded velvet cloak with red lining, which fits the black-and-red palette, but the listing gives few details and it is a generic Underwraps item.
63-inch black velvet hooded cape with black satin flocked lining is a dramatic floor-length option, but the lining is black rather than oxblood and it is sized for female adults.

pieces.name: White ruffled shirt
pieces.styleNotes: Crisp white cotton or poly-cotton shirt with a frothy jabot front and ruffled cuffs, in a Victorian or 1970s romantic style.
queries: vintage white ruffled jabot shirt cotton Victorian
handmade white cotton pirate ruffle shirt Etsy
vintage 1970s white ruffle front tuxedo shirt

matches.reason: White men's dress shirt with a three-tiered oversized jabot ruffle front, ruffled 1½-inch cuffs, and a full button front with a 2½-inch collar, made from 100% rayon rather than cotton.
White 100% cotton blouse with a ruffled stand collar, ruffled button cuffs, and larger ruffles flanking the full button front in a Victorian-inspired style.
Victorian-style women's blouse with a ruffled band collar, full button front, and four-button cuffs, with ruffles on the yoke and back rather than a frothy jabot front.

pieces.name: Black waistcoat — wear with your own black trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Fitted black waistcoat in velvet, brocade or wool with a V-neck and small buttons for a tailored Victorian look. Worn over the ruffled shirt with your own black trousers.
queries: vintage black brocade waistcoat Victorian fitted
handmade black velvet vest men's gothic Etsy
vintage black wool waistcoat tailored button front

matches.reason: Black velvet waistcoat with a satin back, satin accent trim and silver-tone metal buttons, in a plush acetate-nylon blend; the velvet matches the cape, though the double-breasted silver buttons are less fitted-Victorian than small buttons.

Black single-breasted Regency-style waistcoat with a seven-button front, stand-up collar with fold-down lapel, inset pockets and a lace-up adjustable back; the early 19th-century cut is a bit earlier than Victorian and the description does not state a V-neck or fabric.

Double-breasted waistcoat in satin with a tone-on-tone floral brocade, notched lapels and antiqued silver-tone buttons, showing late 19th-century details; the description mentions bright white tones, so the colorway is unclear against the black request.

pieces.name: Black tall boots
pieces.styleNotes: Knee-high black leather boots with a low heel and a slightly worn finish, evoking riding boots from the Victorian or equestrian tradition.
queries: vintage black leather knee high riding boots
handmade black leather tall boots Etsy
vintage western wear black tall leather boots

matches.reason: Black leather boots with a 15-inch shaft plus a 3-inch front rise, low heel, square toe, and pull-on loops give a knee-high cavalry and equestrian look.
Made of 100% top grain leather with a low heel, leather pull-on loops, and a wood-construction sole with leather outsole, though the 12-inch shaft sits at mid-calf rather than knee-high.

Faux leather boots with a distressed black finish and 16-17 inch shaft are tall, but the steampunk lacing, buttons, rubber lug sole and inner zipper depart from a Victorian riding boot and the material is not real leather.

pieces.name: Silver brooch
pieces.styleNotes: Antique-style silver brooch with ornate filigree or a dark gemstone, pinned at the cape collar or the shirt's jabot.
queries: vintage sterling silver filigree brooch Victorian
handmade gothic silver brooch dark gemstone Etsy
antique silver tone cameo brooch pin

matches.reason: Sterling silver Celtic knotwork and marcasite frame a green agate cabochon in a cape-ready brooch.
Solid sterling silver brooch with detailed Celtic knotwork, marcasite and agate cabochons in a vintage style finish, with a 3/4 inch pin intended for capes.

A silver-tone sunburst magnetic brooch listed at about 2.5 inches, sold by a costume and historical accessories retailer, so it has no filigree or dark gemstone and reads as generic glamour rather than antique style.
